build_minicmv_model: build a MiniCPMV multimodal model instance to run inference with vision and language inputs
load_minicmv_weights: load HuggingFace-compatible weights into a MiniCPMV model for inference
create_resampler_2d: create a 2D perceiver-resampler with cross-attention for image feature embedding
generate_sincos_pos_embed: generate 1D or 2D sinusoidal positional embeddings for grid-based vision tokens
parse_multimodal_inputs: parse and validate multimodal image pixel or precomputed embedding inputs for MiniCPMV
